reason: Mismatch response to tactile deviants at about 100-250 ms with generators in secondary somatosensory and frontal cortex; by the D-041 rule (different sensory channel and generator -> different marker), as for MK.vMMN. PER-SMMN-001 temporarily uses MK.MMN (auditory). First source Kekoni et al. 1997 (doi:10.1016/S0301-0511(97)05249-6); generator evidence still to be searched (curator_a, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).

name_en: Neural tracking of a music (instrument) envelope
name_zh: 音乐（乐器）包络的神经追踪
reason: Alternatively generalise MK.speech_envelope_tracking to auditory envelope tracking. PER-MUSAT-002 decodes the attended instrument from EEG tracking of its audio envelope (Cantisani et al. 2019, doi:10.21437/smm.2019-11); MK.speech_envelope_tracking is used as the closest marker (curator_a, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).

name_zh: 过度换气诱发的脑电慢化（build-up）
reason: High-amplitude theta/delta build-up during hyperventilation, resolving after it; STA-RESP-001 temporarily uses MK.slow_wave, which is defined for deep sleep and anaesthesia. Sources: Davis 1942 (doi:10.1001/archneurpsyc.1942.02290040096005); Salvati & Beenhakker 2019 (doi:10.1016/j.brainres.2017.12.037) (curator_e, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).

name_en: Global BOLD response to hypercapnia (cerebrovascular reactivity)
name_zh: 对高碳酸血症的全脑 BOLD 响应（脑血管反应性）
reason: Widespread grey-matter BOLD increase during breath holding, used to map cerebrovascular reactivity; STA-RESP-002 temporarily uses MK.HbO_prefrontal. Sources: Kastrup et al. 1998 (doi:10.1161/01.STR.29.12.2641); Urback et al. 2017 (doi:10.1016/j.neubiorev.2017.05.003) (curator_e, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).
